sentences.text:
2019 
Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.4779 Of 2019
Order:

The petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 3 seek to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.23 of 2019 of Gangavaram Police Station, Chittoor District, which was registered against them for the offence under Sections 188, 273 of IPC and Sec.59(1) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'FSS Act, 2006).

2. The allegations against the petitioners briefly are that on 18.03.2019 at 04.30 P.M., when the complainant along with his staff was conducting vehicle check in the presence of sectorial Magistrate for PS 86 to 73 of Palamner Ac-174, detected that the accused No.1 being the driver and the accused Nos.2 and 3 being the assistant drivers of the Eicher Vehicle were illicitly transporting the Tobacco and its related products banned by the AP State Government without having any bills for their own profit.
Thus, the accused were arrested and seized total 39 gunny bags containing tobacco products were seized.

Later the SI of Police registered a case against the accused Nos.1 to 3 in Crime No.23 of 2019 for the offences stated supra.
3.

Learned counsel for petitioners while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore, the Police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore, registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the order of this Court in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the criminal petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioners under Sections 188, 273 of IPC and Sec.59(1) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, Interlocutory Applications pending, if any, in this case shall stand closed.
MS HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE U. DURGA PRASAD RAO CRIMINAL PETITION No.4779 OF 2019 Date.
